name: Exploding Ice Flowers Trap (CR 2)
body:
Exploding Ice Flowers Trap
CR 2

Type magical; Perception DC 28; Disable Device DC 28

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset no reset
Effect spell effect, glyph of warding [blast], 5th-level cleric, 2d8 cold, DC 14 Reflex save for half damage, multiple targets (all targets within 5 feet) Should anyone pass through trigger area, a chrysanthemum erupts into showers of needle-sharp ice shards.
